sourceRefs.locator: Opening and attendance paragraphs: 10 July 511 conclusion, the king’s summons, thirty-two bishops and their seven provinces.
ER 1039, canon 5, Latin and translation: proceeds of gifts and fields from the king for buildings, support of priests and the poor, or ransoming captives.

processingNote.de: Der Punkt verortet die heutige Stadt. Ein bestimmtes historisches Gebäude lässt sich damit nicht bestimmen.
processingNote.en: The point locates the modern town. It does not identify any particular historical building.
